videos.video_subject: Aged 14 Cristiano Ronaldo was expelled from school after throwing a chair at a teacher who he said had disrespected him; his mother supported his decision to leave school and commit fully to football
videos.video_script: At fourteen, a teacher humiliated him in front of the class. He threw a chair at him. He was expelled that week. His mother never sent him back, football was the only plan left.
